resources.string: Sign in with GitHub, no Tailscale needed
Your server hosts the dashboard on your tailnet. Enter its MagicDNS name. This phone has to be signed in to the same tailnet.

The app sends nothing anywhere but your server, the Aether edge that relays to it in Aether Edge mode, and github.com, which it asks for the newest release\'s tag when the app comes to the front, about once an hour, when you tap Check for updates, and in Aether Edge mode also while the dashboard is open. Privacy policy: https://github.com/3xDevOps/Aether/blob/main/docs/privacy.md
Enter the server\'s tailnet name, for example my-server.tailnet-name.ts.net
The dashboard is served over HTTPS only. Enter the server\'s tailnet name, or an https:// address.
A server address carries no username or password.
Join and claim links open in Aether Edge mode. Choose Aether Edge under Connection, then tap the link again.
The dashboard\'s renderer stopped responding and was ended
Google Play installs it. Nothing downloads until you update there.
Download update fetches aether-android.apk in your browser. Open it, and Android asks you to confirm, checks it is signed like this app, and installs it over this app with your settings and sign-in.
